title: 2026-11-21 — Iterate new code's lints on the clippy leg, not on `fast`

data.head: ## 2026-11-21 — Iterate new code's lints on the clippy leg, not on `fast`

body:
`bash .github/scripts/ci-leg.sh fast` stops at the first clippy run that reads red. Two lints in two targets of new code
(one in a library module, one in its unit test) then cost two full `fast` firings, each rebuilding up to clippy again.
When a change adds code, run `bash .github/scripts/ci-leg.sh clippy` alone until it reads clean, then fire `fast` once.

The engine now reads `size` on a single-choice select in every document: a display size above 1 makes it an in-flow list box of its rows, display size 1 (absent, 1, 0, empty or unparsable) keeps the drop-down.
A single list box opens no list on a click, Enter or Space; its arrows, Home, End and typeahead choose a row through the one write path and scroll it into view; a click on a row focuses the select and chooses that row alone.
In the accessibility tree a select reads ListBox wherever it is a list box (multiple, or display size above 1), else ComboBox; a single list box writes no expanded, no active descendant and reads no author aria-expanded.
A single list box may stand with nothing chosen; the snapshot bridge no longer treats it as a closed select, so its rows carry their own bounds and a click on one is accepted, not covered.
Measured: a list-box page with rows scrolled out of the box lints four findings at boot (clipped, truncated, off-screen; no overlap), and a node a restyle turns display none keeps its last client rect.
Retired: the stated limit that a single select's size is unread; the driver's click and press help texts re-worded, no verb, key, field or cause added.

The engine now reads the size attribute of a single select in every document: a single select whose size parses above 1 is an in-flow list box of its rows, opening no popup list, and display size 1 (size 1, 0, negative, non-numeric, empty or absent) keeps the drop-down.
A single list box chooses by its own keys (arrows, Home, End, typeahead) and by a click on a row, both through the one select write path; Enter, Space and other keys do nothing, and it may stand with nothing chosen.
The accessibility tree reads ListBox for any list box (multiple or sized), ComboBox otherwise; expanded and the active descendant are written on a drop-down alone, and a list box reads no author aria-expanded.
The bridge's closed-select reader answers none for a list box, so its rows are snapshotted, acted on and linted like page content; the driver's click and press help texts are re-worded with no verb, argument, key name, field, cause, exit, log field or span added.
Retired: the stated limit that a single select's size is unread. Measured: a sized list box with rows scrolled out lints its hidden rows as clipped, truncated or off-screen at boot, and a node a restyle turns display none keeps its last client rect.
